Module com.tasktopia
Package com.tasktopia.model

Interface ITaskDAO

All Known Implementing Classes:
MockTaskDAO, SqliteTaskDAO
public interface ITaskDAO
Data Access Object interface for Task entities.

Defines the standard CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations that any concrete task DAO implementation must provide, whether backed by a real database or an in-memory mock.

  • Method Details

    • addTask

      void addTask(Task task)
      Persists a new task to the data store. Implementations should assign a generated ID back to the provided task object after a successful insert.
      Parameters:
      task - the Task to add; must not be null

    • updateTask

      void updateTask(Task task)
      Updates an existing task record in the data store. The task is identified by its id.
      Parameters:
      task - the Task containing updated values; must not be null

    • deleteTask

      void deleteTask(Task task)
      Removes a task from the data store. The task is identified by its id.
      Parameters:
      task - the Task to delete; must not be null

    • getTask

      Task getTask(int id)
      Retrieves a single task by its unique ID.
      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the task to retrieve
      Returns:
      the matching Task, or null if no task with that ID exists

    • getAllTasks

      List<Task> getAllTasks()
      Retrieves all tasks stored in the data store.
      Returns:
      a List of all Task objects; never null, but may be empty if no tasks exist

    • getTasksByUser

      List<Task> getTasksByUser(int userId)
      Retrieves all tasks belonging to a specific user.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user whose tasks should be retrieved
      Returns:
      a List of Task objects owned by the given user; never null, but may be empty
